description: Interactive Git Tree for each project: commit DAG visualization, branch/tag/stash actions, commit details & diff viewer, two-commit comparisons, code reviews, and agent tools.
overview:
View an interactive Git Tree of your project repository in Zana Command Center.

## What you get

- A per-project Git Tree tab. It can open in its own window or split pane.
- A commit DAG with local and remote branches, tags, stashes, HEAD, and uncommitted changes.
- Commit details, changed files, inline or side-by-side diffs, and two-commit comparison.
- Persistent code review. Track which files you reviewed across Zana sessions.
- Git actions from the context menu: branches, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert, reset, tags, stashes, and remotes.
- Agent and CLI integration: start a thread with commit context, run `zcc git-tree` from the terminal, or let agents inspect history with `git_tree_inspect`.

## How it works

The plugin reads your project's Git repository on the host. Mutating actions run `git` only when you choose them from the tree.

## Requirements

A Git repository in the project. The plugin uses your local `git` installation.
